prompt: Use $apple-hig. Adapt this iPad invoice editor for Arabic, a compact resizable window, hardware keyboard and 200% text. Preserve totals and editing state. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place and write result.md with the concrete result, decisions, acceptance checks and what evidence is still missing.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS. Compact width is 420 pt. Layout has fixed left-aligned columns, clips 200% labels and uses red/green-only payment state. Arabic vendor name: مؤسسة النور. Invoice ID: INV-2026-04. Email: accounts@example.test. Amount: 1,240.50 SAR. App mirrors all numerals and play icons mechanically; Tab cannot reach Add line. Resizing resets entered quantities.

criteria.task_completion: Patch layout, bidi direction and keyboard access while retaining the exact invoice values and edited state.
criteria.hig_correctness: Use semantic leading/trailing hierarchy but preserve appropriate numeric/identifier direction and distinguish mirroring of navigation from universal symbols.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Deliver a task-specific corrected artifact or evidence-grounded audit with worked states/transitions and observable checks; a generic checklist is insufficient.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Keep large text usable, explicit payment state and complete keyboard task access; checks must cover compact and enlarged text together.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Do not invent native runtime results, unseen semantics, device support, measurements or source authority; distinguish source conflict and unresolved product constraints.

critical_errors: Corrupts invoice IDs, email or numerical totals by mechanical text reversal.
Claims 200% text support while retaining essential clipping.
Provides only a report without patching interface.md.
